name: The Twelve
description: The ruling council of philosophers of Meletis, meeting in the great hall of governance.

timeline.summary: Iris refuses to hide, but Perisophia and the Twelve decide she must be moved to the garrison at Soli because enemy agents have infiltrated Meletis.
timeline.quote: We have conferred with the Temple and agreed that you will be moved to the garrison at Soli

relations.note: She is the Speaker of the Twelve.
relations.quote: The speaker of the Twelve looked out over the salt marsh.

relations.note: Perisophia is the current head of the Twelve.
relations.quote: said Perisophia, the current head of the ruling council of philosophers known as the Twelve.

pages_say.description: The governing council of Meletis whose speaker is Perisophia.
The ruling council of philosophers of Meletis, meeting in the great hall of governance.
